about.shortBio: B.Tech Computer Science student at Bennett University (CGPA 8.75/10.0). Architecting high-throughput backend services, cryptographic pipelines, and uncertainty-aware ML frameworks.
about.longBio: I design computational tools for complex operations. As the outgoing Chairperson of the IEEE Student Branch at Bennett University (2025–26 tenure), I led a 100+ member vertical structure to construct software products, secure sponsorships (₹1.48L+), and spearhead international events like the Global AI Summit 2.0 (3,000–4,000+ attendees) and Triverse 3.0. First-author of a research manuscript on staged uncertainty-aware fraud decisioning targeting IEEE TDSC.
